basis: SCID defined by defective development of T and B lymphocytes; secondary organ infections are separate diseases.

decisions.haematologic: primary: failure of T- and B-lymphocyte development directly affects blood cells, alongside the defining immunodeficiency.

basis: Ureteral triplication and the characteristic vertebral, hip and limb malformations define urinary and skeletal involvement. Cardiac and neurologic frequencies are unknown; amastia has no axis.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the constellation of hemivertebrae, scoliosis, congenital hip dislocation and limb malformations constitutes the syndrome's skeletal dysmorphism.

basis: Skin/hair and amino-acid abnormalities define the syndrome; intellectual impairment affected 1/2 reported siblings ([report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/843456/)). Renal damage is unestablished.

decisions.renal: none: aminoaciduria alone does not establish renal injury or a specific tubular transport defect; its mechanism is unspecified.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the defining amino-acid handling abnormality establishes a metabolic phenotype, although the biochemical mechanism remains unspecified.

basis: The definition specifies inherited susceptibility rather than existing melanoma or skin damage; future tumour risk does not establish organ involvement.

decisions.dermatologic: none: the concept denotes predisposition only; assigning skin damage would label a later risk as existing disease.

basis: Cutaneous histiocytosis; supplied HPO reports osteolysis in 80-99% and diabetes insipidus from hypothalamic-pituitary involvement in 30-79%. Individual airway findings are occasional.

decisions.haematologic: none: tissue histiocytic proliferation does not establish blood-cell or marrow disease ([report](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4006584/)).

basis: Cyclic neutrophil deficiency impairs innate immunity; recurrent oral ulceration and gingivitis cause mucosal injury in 30-79%. Secondary infections are separate diseases; periodontitis is <30%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: recurrent oral ulceration and gingivitis directly injure oral tissues in 30-79%; these are intrinsic mucosal manifestations, beyond pain or transient redness.

basis: Prenatal brain destruction with characteristic calvarial collapse and overlapping sutures defines the sequence; redundant scalp alone does not establish skin damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: calvarial collapse and overlapping sutures are defining structural skeletal abnormalities ([original series](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2308027/)).

basis: THRA resistance directly causes neurodevelopmental impairment and skeletal dysplasia in >30% each; anemia occurs in 77% of reported evaluable cases. Constipation alone does not establish gut damage.

decisions.haematologic: involved: intrinsic anemia occurred in 23/30 evaluable cases (77%), supporting common impaired erythropoiesis ([analysis](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7947725/)).

basis: Defined by peripheral or autonomic nerve damage; diabetes is the separate underlying disease, and local nerve microangiopathy does not establish another organ disorder.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: diabetic neuropathy labels the nerve complication; the underlying diabetes does not independently establish endocrine organ damage within this concept.

basis: Intracranial meningeal tumour; direct cochleovestibular nerve compression impairs hearing commonly, approximately 40-60%, independently of treatment.

decisions.otologic: involved: tumour-related hearing dysfunction is common; hearing loss was present at presentation in 46/80 patients (58%) ([series](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12396866/)).
